evals.prompt: I want to build a small internal dashboard for support tickets. Interview me first, then write a short spec with stages, 5-minute tasks, and agent owners. Keep future ideas out of the actionable plan unless I approve them.
evals.expected_output: A concise Markdown spec created after clarification, with clear discovery and architecture decisions, checkbox stages, explicit agent ownership, open questions, and unapproved work logged outside the actionable plan.

evals.prompt: Help me plan a refactor of our billing service. I need you to ask questions until the migration risks and boundaries are clear, then turn it into a worker-ready spec file.
evals.expected_output: A short refactor spec that clarifies service boundaries, risks, and staging, and breaks approved work into small tasks assigned to fixed agent roles.

evals.prompt: I have an idea for a browser extension that saves snippets into project folders. Interview me and write a contract-style spec my workers can follow. Leave possible integrations in out-of-scope unless I explicitly approve them.
evals.expected_output: A concise product spec with resolved ambiguities, a consistent section layout, explicit task ownership, and optional integrations kept out of the actionable checklist.
